fields.mechanism: Structural reinforcement through composite materials with stress-distribution properties
fields.intervention: Incorporate carbon fiber reinforced polymer (CFRP) components at stress points in the knee prosthesis design to distribute mechanical loads more evenly and prevent detachment
fields.expected_effect: Reduced stress concentration points that lead to component detachment while maintaining flexibility and function
fields.falsification_test: Accelerated fatigue testing comparing traditional metal components versus CFRP-reinforced components under simulated walking cycles with increasing loads
fields.mechanism_source_span: The safety and performance of hip and knee prostheses can be assessed by analyzing peer-reviewed literature, registry reports, and safety notices published by national competent authorities/regulatory agencies, or manufacturers.

fields.mechanism: Multi-source surveillance of implant performance across peer-reviewed literature, registries, regulatory notices, and manufacturer reports
fields.intervention: Develop integrated monitoring dashboard that aggregates and analyzes data from all four sources specifically for knee prosthesis attachment mechanisms
fields.expected_effect: Identification of early warning patterns for detachment events enabling preventive maintenance or design modifications
fields.falsification_test: Track false positive/negative rates of the dashboard against actual detachment events in retrospective analysis
fields.mechanism_source_span: "We aimed to assess the frequency of signals identified for a random sample of 10 hip stems, 10 hip cups, and 10 knee implants. Methods 3 literature libraries were searched to find safety signals defined as information on patterns/occurrences that may alter the device's benefit-risk profile, reported in peer-reviewed publications for the randomly selected implants. Annual registry reports from 5 national registries were examined to check whether any of the selected implants had outlier performance. The CORE-MD post-market surveillance (PMS) tool was used to collect all related safety notices from 13 competent authority/regulatory agency websites. Manufacturers' websites were screened for any reported safety information."

fields.mechanism: Safety signal identification through multi-source surveillance including peer-reviewed literature, registry reports, and safety notices
fields.intervention: Implement a comprehensive post-market surveillance system that monitors and analyzes safety signals from multiple sources for knee prosthesis devices
fields.expected_effect: Early detection of detachment patterns and other failure modes before they result in patient injuries
fields.falsification_test: Compare failure rates between knee prostheses with and without the implemented multi-source surveillance system over a 5-year period
fields.mechanism_source_span: The safety and performance of hip and knee prostheses can be assessed by analyzing peer-reviewed literature, registry reports, and safety notices published by national competent authorities/regulatory agencies, or manufacturers.

fields.mechanism: Multi-domain stress distribution system combining mechanical reinforcement with adaptive damping
fields.intervention: Incorporate a viscoelastic polymer layer with embedded microfluidic channels into the bone-implant interface of the knee prosthesis
fields.expected_effect: Reduce stress concentrations at the bone-implant interface while absorbing impact forces, preventing detachment
fields.falsification_test: Accelerated fatigue testing simulating 10 years of use with 3x normal body weight loading cycles, comparing detachment rates between modified and standard prostheses
fields.mechanism_source_span: Background and purpose The safety and performance of hip and knee prostheses can be assessed by analyzing peer-reviewed literature, registry reports, and safety notices published by national competent authorities/regulatory agencies, or manufacturers.

fields.mechanism: Enhanced interface design between prosthetic components to prevent detachment under dynamic loading conditions
fields.intervention: Implementing a tapered Morse taper with additional locking mechanism at the bone-implant interface
fields.expected_effect: Reduce detachment events by distributing mechanical stresses more evenly and creating a mechanical interlock
fields.falsification_test: Cyclic loading test simulating 10 years of gait cycles with measurements of micromotion and component separation
